tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Check if a .i sovereign domain is available for registration across all 4 supported chains (Arbitrum One, Optimism, Ethereum, Robinhood).

tools.name: resolve_domain_identity
tools.description: Resolve a .i web3 domain name or 0x Ethereum wallet address to its sovereign identity, owner, metadata, social links, and current chain location.

tools.name: get_supported_chains
tools.description: Retrieve technical network specifications, Chainlink CCIP selectors, router contracts, and registry addresses for all 4 supported chains.

tools.name: estimate_registration
tools.description: Calculate registration fee, escrow payment requirements, and cross-chain CCIP bridging costs on any of the 4 supported networks.

tools.name: set_primary_domain
tools.description: Set or update the primary reverse resolution domain identity for a given wallet address.

tools.name: update_domain_profile
tools.description: Update decentralized identity profile metadata, social links, website URL, and IPFS avatar CID.

tools.name: marketplace_browse_listings
tools.description: Browse active .i domains listed on the decentralized secondary marketplace across Arbitrum One and satellite networks.

tools.name: marketplace_get_domain_details
tools.description: Inspect full marketplace status for any .i domain: active listing, price history, highest offer, and bids.

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Register a permanent .i sovereign domain or generate on-chain transaction payload for contract execution across the 4 networks.

tools.name: marketplace_list_domain
tools.description: List an owned .i domain for sale on the decentralized secondary marketplace at a fixed price in ETH.

tools.name: marketplace_buy_domain
tools.description: Instantly purchase an actively listed .i domain from the secondary marketplace using ETH.

tools.name: marketplace_make_offer
tools.description: Submit an offer in ETH to purchase any registered .i domain.

tools.name: marketplace_accept_offer
tools.description: Accept a buyer offer on your .i domain, performing an atomic swap of ownership for the offered ETH.

tools.name: marketplace_cancel_listing
tools.description: Cancel an active marketplace listing for an owned .i domain.

tools.name: marketplace_cancel_offer
tools.description: Cancel an active marketplace offer and release non-custodial or escrowed funds.

tools.name: transfer_domain
tools.description: Transfer sovereign ownership of a .i domain directly to another 0x EVM wallet address.

tools.name: bridge_domain
tools.description: Initiate cross-chain teleportation/bridging of a .i domain to another supported EVM chain via Chainlink CCIP.

tools.name: claim_escrow_refund
tools.description: Claim a refund for an escrow deposit (e.g. from registration race collisions or expired bridging operations).

tools.name: get_protocol_stats
tools.description: Fetch live protocol metrics including total registered domains, active secondary marketplace listings, and cross-chain CCIP bridge health.
